articles.title: Challenges of Digital Transformation in the Philippine Public Sector 🇵🇭
articles.summary: Working in IT in the public sector has taught me that digital transformation is not just about introducing new systems or technologies. One of the biggest challenges is working with existing processes that were designed long before digital tools became part of everyday operations. Sometimes, even if a better system is available, policies, procurement processes, limited resources, infrastructure, and resistance to change can slow down implementation. Another challenge is systems integration. Different offices may use different platforms, databases, or even separate spreadsheets, which makes sharing information and getting a complete picture difficult. There is also the challenge of balancing innovation with security, data privacy, compliance, and accountability. In government, technology needs to work not only technically, but also within existing rules and responsibilities. And probably one of the most important challenges is adoption.
